**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: DENIED**

**Service:** Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775)  
**Order Date:** May 31, 2025

---

**CRITERIA REVIEW:**

**BMI Requirement – MET**  
Current BMI 42.8 kg/m² (5/21/2025) exceeds the required minimum of 35 kg/m².

**Prior Weight Management – MET**  
Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program with dietitian involvement and phentermine trial. Net weight loss of 2 kg was regained after discontinuation, documented as unsuccessful.

**Covered Procedure – MET**  
Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy is a covered procedure type.

**Obesity-Related Comorbidities – NOT MET**  
Your bariatric surgery consultation note (doc-003) explicitly states: "No obesity-related comorbidities identified: blood pressure normal, HbA1c 5.3%, sleep study negative for apnea, lipids normal, no joint disease."

Our plan requires documentation of at least one obesity-related comorbidity (such as type 2 diabetes, hypertension, sleep apnea, dyslipidemia, osteoarthritis, or fatty liver disease) to approve bariatric surgery.

---

**NEXT STEPS:**

To appeal this denial, please submit documentation of an obesity-related comorbidity with supporting clinical evidence (lab values, imaging, or specialist evaluation). Contact us if you have questions.
